task: Persist Phase 5 retrospective learnings from the PR #4302 incident: three new memories, two corrections, and the retrospective artifact.

events.content: Ran retrospective skill Phase 0-5 over the PR #4302 incident
Deduplicated candidate learnings against 898 existing memories before writing
Wrote three new memories at 95%, 90%, and 92% atomicity
Corrected two existing memories that would have reproduced the defect
Harvested agent redo4003: PR #4003 merge resolution redone and pushed green

lessons: Search open issues for the target file before designing a fix. gh issue list --state open --limit 400 --search '<filename>' --json number,title
Root-cause bisection names the cause, never the remedy. Write down what the code is structurally, then ask whether the metric that flagged it fits that structure.
An assertion is sound only when its expected value traces to a different authority than the code under test. Mutate the production code and confirm the test goes red. A survivor had one authority.
Avoid: Sampling gh run list with status=completed over a recent-N window to measure CI duration. Paginate to 500+ runs and confirm the workflows you care about appear in the sample by name.
Avoid: Treating a clean bisection as carrying the design forward. Treat the end of diagnosis as the start of design. Search the tracker before writing the remedy.
